title: Web data layer on generateClient (data calls only)
description:
`design/storage.md` §4 (mode switching, facades, domain).

## Steps
1. `web/src/data/client.ts`: fetch `/amplify_outputs.json`, call `Amplify.configure`, export `client = generateClient<Schema>()`.
2. `files.ts` and `auth.ts` facades with the `aws-amplify` signatures. Local mode is implemented now; cloud branches are stubs until apricitus-df37ae.
3. `domain.ts`: `keepCandidate`, `saveSlice`, `saveScore`, `applyVerdict`.
4. Add wasm exports `rw_rank`, `rw_ids` and `rw_markup_merge` in `crates/apricitus-web`, and update the shim types.
5. Replace the `api.*` calls in `web/src/apricitus.ts` and `web/src/ui/{library,score,landing}.ts`. Slices are saved per record. Compiling fetches clips, analysis and slices from the data layer. **Data calls only**: note the change on the issue so the web session sees it.
6. Playwright end-to-end: `web/test/e2e/local.spec.ts` against `serve` on a migrated library. Browse, rename a slice (story apricitus-453448), keep a candidate, save and compile a score.

## Verify
`cd web && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build && npx playwright test`

---
**Repo:** `~/Projects/Ripple`, branch `master` (don't switch).
**Toolchain:** `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH`; Python `analysis/.venv/bin/python`; web `cd web && npm …`.
**Protocol:** initiative `apricitus-e70662`: specs first; log with `kbs comment`; run **Verify** and paste the output tail; label `ready-for-review`; never commit, push, close, or deploy. Don't change visuals in `web/src/ui/*` (the web session owns them); data calls only.
